review_text: The pasta was fresh and the staff made us feel welcome.
Dinner was delicious, but we waited a while for the check.
The dining room was clean and comfortable.
Our server handled an allergy request carefully.
The food was good, though parking was difficult to find.
Lunch arrived quickly and everything tasted fresh.
The soup was flavorful but could have been hotter.
Friendly service and a cozy atmosphere.
